browser.cache: fresh browser context per navigation; service workers blocked; alternating mode order within each repeated route
browser.readiness: network idle; default island strategies; no manual activation or scrolling
browser.memory: JSHeapUsedSize after navigation, not peak RSS
browser.hydration: hydrateRoot call to first passive-effect commit; overlapping roots are summed, excluding dynamic import time
browser.script: CDP ScriptDuration plus duration sums for v8.parseOnBackgroundParsing, v8.compileModule/v8.compile and v8.evaluateModule trace events. Trace durations can overlap and are not exclusive wall times. Tracing is enabled equally for both modes.
browser.gzip: Sum of independently gzip-compressed loaded JS bodies at level 6; server transfer itself is uncompressed

activatedIslands.cache: fresh browser context per navigation; service workers blocked; alternating mode order within each repeated route
activatedIslands.readiness: network idle before activation; scroll visible island, enlarge viewport and dispatch manual event; wait for all five selective hydration commits; after values are cumulative
activatedIslands.memory: JSHeapUsedSize after navigation, not peak RSS
